tools.name: Mumble Note
tools.description:
> *"The fastest AI voice note-taker to capture your scattered thoughts and turn them into organized notes."*

Mumble Note is an AI note-taker designed to be the fastest way to capture your scattered thoughts, and turn them into organized notes. You can speak, type or do them both. AI will combine your inputs together and generate structured, actionable and easy-to-retrieve notes for you.

Our users have been using Mumble Note for quick idea capture, voice journaling, meeting notes, and so much more.

Mumble Note transforms spoken thoughts into structured notes. Users can talk freely to input ideas, to-dos, or meeting notes and transformed them into organized output. It also allows users to add images, generate images covers, create to-do lists, ask AI to rewrite or translate notes, and allow users to use voice edit to make changes as they need.

Mumble Note is available on iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac (Beta) now.
